_doc: 複製人每日學習迴圈設定(scripts/research/clone_agent_learn.py 讀)。challengers 一經登記(verdicts.jsonl 的 register 列)就凍結;改 filter 必須換新 id。

champion.filter: in_list and stars >= 4 and time >= '10:00:00' and time < '12:00:00'

challengers.hypothesis: 放寬到 ★3 以上(同窗 10:00–12:00)後,每筆成本後 60 分超額不低於冠軍;若成立,送單量可放大而不稀釋邊際
challengers.filter: in_list and stars >= 3 and time >= '10:00:00' and time < '12:00:00'

challengers.hypothesis: 10:00–10:30 仍屬開盤後最弱時段(21 天 997 卡:首半小時最弱),砍掉後每筆成本後 60 分超額提高
challengers.filter: in_list and stars >= 4 and time >= '10:30:00' and time < '12:00:00'

challengers.hypothesis: 訊號當下期貨買賣價差 >20bps 的卡,價差吃掉邊際(價差 16.7bps > 選股優勢 8.2bps),排除後每筆成本後 60 分超額提高
challengers.filter: in_list and stars >= 4 and time >= '10:00:00' and time < '12:00:00' and spread_entry_bps <= 20
